nodes.plm_action: Cut the bananas into one-inch (2.5cm) round slices and place them in a mixing bowl.
nodes.plm_caption: This video features a sped up tutorial on making fried plantain chips. The video consists of two separate scenes. The first scene shows a video thumbnail of a channel and channel information scrolling in the upper corners of the frame. The second scene shows a person slice three plantains, cut off the tips and slice them into pieces with a mandoline, heat oil in a wok with water, and then place the plantain chips in the oil and fry them. The fried plantain chips are removed from the wok with a strainer and placed in a serving dish.

summary.brief: A sped‑up video shows a cooking‑channel screen, then hands slice plantains, fry the slices in hot oil, drain them, and finish with promotional slides.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a close‑up of a phone displaying the Lakshmi Paakashaale cooking channel, set on a wooden tabletop decorated with pine branches, a candle and a red “subscribe now” banner. The view then switches to a kitchen where a pair of hands trim the tips off three green plantains and run them through a mandoline to create thin slices. Oil is poured into a wok and heated until shimmering, after which the plantain slices are dropped in and fried until golden‑brown and crispy. Using a slotted spoon or metal strainer, the fried chips are lifted from the oil, drained on a paper towel, and arranged on a serving plate. The cooking segment is followed by a series of slides promoting the channel, ending with a bright subscribe‑button graphic.

action.detailed: Slice the plantains, heat oil in a wok, fry the slices until crisp, strain them from the oil, and place the cooked chips onto a serving dish.

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a fast-motion cooking tutorial as the ingredients are cut and cooked in a pan. It starts with the video showing a phone with a video. Then there is banana chips, raw banana, oil, peeled bananas, banana slices, a grater and the final cooked product that are arranged visually.  Then it goes to the banana, which is raw and peeled, and then after that cut up the banana that is peeled and then set them aside and cut up the other ingredients for the recipe before showing the final dish being cooked in a pan. The video is sped-up.

summary.brief: A fast‑motion tutorial shows a phone screen, then hands peel, slice and fry raw green bananas into crisp chips.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a smartphone displayed on a wooden tabletop, showing the Lakshmi Paakashaale YouTube channel against a holiday‑themed background and a red “SUBSCRIBE NOW” banner. The view then switches to a kitchen where a plate holds several green plantains and a clear‑oil jar sits nearby. A pair of hands peel the plantains using a knife and fingers, discarding the skins and arranging the peeled fruit on the plate. The peeled bananas are thinly sliced, either with a knife or with a large orange/red grater that drops the slices into a bowl. Clear cooking oil is poured into a black skillet on a stovetop and heated. The thin banana slices are added to the hot oil and fried until they turn golden‑brown and crisp. The fried pieces are lifted out with a slotted spoon or strainer and transferred to a serving plate. Near the end of the segment the demonstrator mixes a dough with the hand, forms small balls and drops them into the hot oil for a brief second fry, then removes the resulting fritters onto a plate. Throughout the video overlay text such as “banana chips,” “ingredients,” and a recurring “SUBSCRIBE NOW” banner appear in the upper corner.

action.detailed: Peel the raw green bananas, slice them thinly with a knife or grater, heat oil in a skillet, fry the slices until golden and crisp, lift them out with a slotted spoon onto a plate, then mix a dough and drop small portions into the hot oil for a brief fry.
action.actor: The demonstrator’s hands (the unseen cook) guiding the banana preparation and frying

nodes.plm_caption: In the video you can see banana chips frying in the hot oil. The person takes the chips out of the frying pan and puts them on a paper towel.

summary.brief: Fried banana chips are lifted from hot oil, drained on a paper towel, and the clip ends with promotional graphics.
summary.detailed: The camera shows a pan or wok filled with oil in which thin banana slices sizzle and turn golden brown; a hand uses a slotted spoon or metal strainer to scoop the chips out of the oil, shakes off excess oil, and places the crisp pieces onto a white paper towel before moving them onto a serving plate, after which the video switches to a series of static slides and banner graphics urging viewers to subscribe.

action.brief: Remove and drain fried banana chips
action.detailed: Lift the fried banana chips from the hot oil with a slotted spoon, shake off the excess oil, and set the chips onto a paper towel.
action.actor: A person's hands (the cook) visible in the frame

nodes.plm_caption:
A phone is seen open with a youtube app on the screen. Then a person is grabbing some chips and cutting them. After, bananas and oil are placed on a plate.
A mobile phone is seen open with a youtube app on the screen, the person is clicking in one of the videos. Then, some chips are seen to be placed on a surface.
A person is seen grabbing some chips with his finger. The chips are then seen on a plate.
One after the other, some chips are seen to be placed on a surface. Later, a person is seen holding a bunch of chips. Then a bunch of raw bananas are seen placed on a plate.
A glass filled with oil is seen.
The video shows how to make some banana chips, raw bananas and oil for a dish.

summary.brief: The clip shows a phone screen with the Lakshmi Paakashaale YouTube channel, then hands demonstrate the early steps of making banana chips.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a close‑up of a smartphone placed on a wooden surface; the screen displays the Lakshmi Paakashaale YouTube channel page with a festive holiday background, subscriber count and a red “SUBSCRIBE NOW” banner, while pine cones, cinnamon sticks, a candle and acorns decorate the surrounding area. After a few seconds the view shifts to a pair of hands. A hand picks up a small banana chip from a plate of homemade chips, breaks it in half and peels it. The hands then show a plate of raw green bananas and lift a clear glass jar of oil, move the jar beside the bananas, raise it again and remove it from view. Throughout this segment text overlays and a subscribe banner appear, and the setting remains an indoor, well‑lit space with a brown wall in the background.

action.detailed: Break and peel a banana chip, arrange raw green bananas on a plate, lift a glass jar of oil, place it beside the bananas, then move the jar away.

nodes.plm_caption: A food product is being prepared in a frying pan.

summary.brief: Oil is heated in a skillet, green plantains are peeled and sliced, and dough balls are fried.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with clear cooking oil being poured into a black skillet on a stove while a red "SUBSCRIBE NOW" banner is visible in the corner. A pair of hands then peel several green plantains, removing the skin with a knife and fingers and placing the peeled fruit on a white plate. The peeled plantains are sliced into thin pieces, first with a knife and then with an orange handheld grater, and the slices are collected in a metal bowl or plate. After the slicing, the hands mix a soft dough, shape it into small round pieces, and add those pieces to the hot oil in the same skillet. The dough pieces sizzle and float as they fry. When the plantain slices and dough balls turn golden and crisp, they are lifted out with a slotted utensil and transferred onto a serving plate.

action.detailed: Heat oil in a skillet, peel and slice green plantains, mix dough and form small balls, drop both the banana slices and dough balls into the hot oil, fry until golden and crisp, then remove them with a slotted spoon and place them on a plate.
action.actor: A person's hands (a woman) preparing the ingredients

nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a very busy shot of someone frying in oil in a pan. The first action is a pan full of oil in the middle of the screen with some pieces of cut chips in it and the hands holding a slotted spoon in the air in the top right corner. The next object shown is the hand with the strainer and chips frying up in the air. The hand then puts the chips in a plate. Then back to the oil in the pan. The next shot is a plate with a white table cloth and chips piled on the left. The next shot is oil in the pan being stirred around and then is being used to cook chips. Next is oil in the pan, and then finally back to frying chips in oil, then into the plate.

summary.brief: Banana chips are fried in hot oil, lifted with a slotted spoon, and placed onto a plate.
summary.detailed: The camera repeatedly shows a pan of hot oil with sliced banana pieces sizzling. A hand reaches in with a slotted spoon or mesh strainer, lifts the golden‑brown chips out of the oil, shakes off excess oil, and drops them onto a plate set on a white tablecloth. The pan is then shown again as more chips are added, fried, and transferred in the same way until a pile of crispy banana chips is gathered on the plate.

action.detailed: The cook lifts the sizzling banana slices from the oil with a slotted spoon, shakes off the oil, and places them onto a plate, repeating the process until all the chips are fried and served.
action.actor: The person cooking, visible only by their hands

nodes.plm_caption: This video features an advertisement for a recipe channel, it includes some slides that promotes the channel. At the end a yellow banner with a subscribe button is shown.

summary.brief: A promotional slideshow showing fried plantain chips with overlay graphics and a final subscribe banner.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a close‑up of a hand reaching into a white bowl and lifting a few small, round, golden‑brown plantain chips, briefly inspecting them before returning them to the bowl. The view then cuts to several quick close‑up shots of the chips arranged on a white plate with a cloth, on another white plate, and finally spread on a green banana leaf, highlighting their crisp yellow colour. Throughout these clips bright graphic overlays appear, including red banners that read “Subscribe for more recipes” and “Subscribe now”, the channel name “Lakshmi Paakashaale”, and prompts such as “Like, Share, Comment”. Additional snippets show the chips on a silver grate and animated arrows and flashing text like “Thanks for watching” and “Subscribe for more recipes”. The segment ends with a static advertisement screen featuring a pink‑yellow background, a red flame icon, a gold circle with an arrow, and prominent text commands “More videos” and “Click to subscribe”.

action.detailed: Pick up a few small, round fried plantain chips with your hand, examine them briefly, and place them back into the bowl or onto the plate while promotional graphics appear on the screen.

nodes.plm_action: Pressing the bell icon to activate the notification bell
nodes.plm_caption: The video is showing a stationary YouTube channel graphic on a mobile phone screen. The channel page is for a channel called "lakshmi pakaashaale". The channel has a subscriber count of 2,576 subscribers. It has a logo of a picture of two green leaves with a butterfly, and the profile icon of a woman with purple hair. The background of the mobile phone screen is white. Behind the mobile phone screen is a wooden table. There are pine needles, a pine cone, cinnamon sticks, and a burning candle in a red and brown glass jar, and a few acorns.

summary.brief: A smartphone screen shows the Lakshmi Paakashaale YouTube channel against a festive wooden backdrop with a red “Subscribe now” banner.
summary.detailed: The clip shows a stationary phone placed on a wooden tabletop that is decorated with pine needles, a pine cone, cinnamon sticks, a candle in a red‑brown glass jar, and a few acorns. The phone’s display presents the Lakshmi Paakashaale YouTube channel page: the channel logo of two green leaves with a butterfly, a profile picture of a woman with purple hair, a subscriber count of about 2,576, and a large thumbnail of a green leaf. A bright red “Subscribe now” banner appears in the top‑right corner of the screen along with the usual YouTube UI elements. An on‑screen hand‑shaped cursor briefly moves to point at the subscribe button (or the play button) and highlights it, after which the view remains static for the remainder of the segment.

action.detailed: An on‑screen hand‑shaped cursor moves to the red “Subscribe now” button on the YouTube channel page and briefly highlights it for the viewer.

nodes.plm_caption: A video shows a person's hands demonstrating how to make banana chips. A person takes a banana chip, tears it apart, and begins peeling each one individually. A plate of unpeeled and peeled green bananas is shown, and then the person grabs a cup filled with oil. The banana chips can be seen on top of a wire rack and the video has a close up view of them and then a hand holding a banana chip. The video has "lakhmi paakashaale," a name displayed in the center. The end screen has a red banner that reads "subscribe now. ".

summary.brief: A close‑up shows banana chips on a rack with promotional text, a hand breaking and peeling a chip, then raw green bananas and a cup of oil are displayed.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of golden‑brown banana chips arranged on a wire rack, overlaid with yellow "Welcome", a red "Subscribe Now" banner and the title "Lakshmi Paakashaale". A hand enters the frame, lifts a single chip, breaks it in half and peels off its thin skin. The view then shifts to a decorative plate holding several unripe green bananas, beside a clear cup filled with oil. The same hand lifts the cup, lowers it and moves it slightly while keeping the bananas in view, with the promotional overlays remaining on screen throughout.

action.detailed: Pick up a banana chip, break it in half, peel off its skin, then lift and move a cup of oil while displaying a plate of raw green bananas.

nodes.plm_caption:
The video features a woman preparing a frying dish, specifically cutting up a plantain and frying them in oil in a skillet. A few plates with a plantain and a plate of oil are also shown. The video is set in a kitchen with a few red color highlights, and the red banner in the upper right corner says, "subscribe now."
The video begins with a shot of a white round plate with 4 green plantains on it and a white plastic cup half full of a gray liquid. There is a white pot lid behind them. It fades to a black skillet with a black handle being placed on a stove burner. A person's hand places a light blue liquid in the skillet.

It cuts quickly to a closeup of a hand holding a single green plantain, which is being peeled. The right hand is slicing off the top layer with a knife, then peels off the rest. The left hand is holding the plantain, and all the layers are sliced and peeled off.

The right hand then turns the plantain and continues peeling. Then they use their fingers to pull the peel. They separate the peel from the plantain and peel off the rest.

The right hand puts the peeled, white plantain on the plate containing the other plantains. The hands then grab another green plantain and place it over the white plate.

The right hand slices through the peel of the new plantain, peeling it off and placing it on the plate. Then they use their fingers to pull the peel off.

The left hand rotates the plantain around to be on the right.

It fades to the black skillet on the stove, where the pot lid is placed.

Then the video fades away.

summary.brief: Oil is poured into a skillet and a woman peels several green plantains, placing the peeled pieces on a plate.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a black skillet on a stove burner. A hand tips a bottle and pours clear cooking oil into the pan, where the oil swirls across the surface, and a lid is then placed on the skillet. The view shifts to a white plate holding green plantains. Using a knife, the right hand trims the tip of a plantain, then both hands pull off the outer peel, revealing the white flesh, which is set on the plate. The process is repeated with another plantain: the tip is sliced off, the skin is peeled with fingers, the fruit is rotated as needed, and the peeled piece is added to the plate. Throughout, a red “SUBSCRIBE NOW” banner appears in the upper‑right corner, and the segment ends with a fade‑out.

action.detailed: Trim the tip of each green plantain with a knife, pull off the skin with both hands, and arrange the peeled pieces on a plate.

nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a person making banana fritters. They take four bananas and peel them, cut them into two halves, cut those into three parts, and use a manual slicer to slice them. In the bowl they keep, they make some space for the sliced bananas. Then they fry the sliced bananas in cooking oil to make banana fritters.  Once they cook, they take out the cooked banana fritters and place them into a plate next to them.  The video was well lit, and the color of the lighting of the wall is brown.

summary.brief: Bananas and vegetables are grated, then dough balls are fried in hot oil.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a pair of hands placing several peeled bananas on a silver plate and using an orange handheld grater to grate them into thin slices that fall into a silver bowl and onto the plate; a second white plate with a pink floral design holds a few of the slices. A black countertop and brown wall form the background. The hands continue to grate, moving bananas over a clear glass bowl. The focus then shifts to a metal bowl where thin white vegetable slices (appearing to be radish or potato) are added with a red peeler, while a white floral plate is visible behind. The cook mixes the sliced pieces into a soft dough with the fingers. A black frying pan on a stove is filled with hot oil; the hand drops several small round dough balls into the bubbling oil, where they fry and turn golden. The cooked pieces are lifted out with a utensil and placed onto a serving plate. A red “SUBSCRIBE NOW” banner overlays the corner throughout, and the lighting is bright with warm tones.

action.detailed: Grate the bananas and other vegetables, mix the slices into a dough, then drop the dough balls into hot oil and fry them until golden before removing them onto a plate.
action.actor: A person’s hands (a woman) preparing the food

nodes.plm_action: Remove the fried cookies with tongs and place them on a paper towel to drain.
nodes.plm_caption: The video showcases the cooking process of a batter by placing slices of various fruits or vegetables into a hot oil filled pan using a tool to separate the slices, removing the fried batter, and adding a large portion of flour to the pan.

summary.brief: Banana slices are fried, drained onto a napkin, and a white ingredient is grated into the hot oil alongside added batter pieces.
summary.detailed: The camera shows thin banana slices being tossed in hot oil until they turn golden brown. A metal strainer lifts the fried slices out of the pan and deposits them onto a white napkin. The cook then returns to the pan, holds a handheld grater and shaves a white, cheese‑like ingredient directly into the sizzling oil, where it melts. Immediately after, small pieces of batter or dough are dropped from a red container into the same oil, where they begin to fry.

action.detailed: Fry the banana slices in hot oil, drain them onto a napkin, grate a white ingredient into the oil, and add batter pieces to fry.

nodes.plm_action: Drain the fritters on a paper towel.
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a close up shot of a large black wok filled with sliced plantains and covered in a pan on a stovetop until they're tender, where they are turned and stirred with a slotted skimmer, then removed to the left of the frame.
To begin the video the camera zooms in on the contents of the wok, before quickly panning to the right showing a metal handle of the strainer used to stir the plantains. The video ends with an orange text graphic reading "subscribe for more recipes" in the top right corner of the frame.
Over the 14 second duration of the video the camera remains focused on the plantains and the wok which has a red, digital logo superimposed in the top right corner of the frame throughout. To the left of the frame there is text also reading "lakshmi paakashaale" throughout the duration of the video.

summary.brief: Plantain slices fry in a black wok, are stirred with a slotted skimmer, and are lifted onto a plate.
summary.detailed: The camera stays focused on a large black wok on the stove, where thin plantain slices are sizzling in hot oil. A hand holding a metal slotted skimmer repeatedly lifts, flips, and stirs the pieces to keep them cooking evenly. When the slices turn golden, the skimmer scoops them out of the wok and deposits the crisp chips onto a plate positioned to the left of the frame. Throughout the clip a white watermark reading “Lakshmi Paakashaale” appears on the left side, a red “Subscribe” button is visible in the upper‑right corner, and the segment ends with an orange graphic that says “Subscribe for more recipes.”

action.brief: Stir and transfer fried plantain chips
action.detailed: Using a slotted skimmer, stir and flip the plantain slices in the hot oil, then scoop them out of the wok and place the crispy chips onto a serving plate.
action.actor: the cook’s hand holding a slotted skimmer

nodes.plm_caption: A video of a person picking up small, yellow pieces of food and then a pile of potato chips, with the final scene showing more video clips. The words "subscribe for more recipes" appear at the top of the shot.

summary.brief: A hand lifts and examines small fried plantain chips while promotional graphics are overlaid.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a close‑up of a white bowl or plate holding tiny, round, yellow fried plantain chips. A hand reaches in, picks up a couple of chips, briefly holds them together, and then returns them to the bowl. The view then shifts to other piles of the same chips arranged on a white cloth, a green banana leaf, and a plate. Throughout these shots, bright overlay banners appear with messages such as “subscribe for more recipes,” “like share comment,” and the channel name “Lakshmi Paakashaale.” The later part of the segment shows rapid close‑up clips of the chips on green surfaces and in a glass bowl, again with the same promotional text, and ends with an end‑screen displaying additional video thumbnails and a “subscribe now” button.

action.detailed: Pick up two small fried plantain chips with a hand, hold them together briefly, and place them back onto the bowl or plate.

nodes.plm_caption: A yellow and pink screen with a red background is displayed with a flame-like image in the center and "more videos" at the top. It also displays a round gold emblem with a red arrow that says "click to subscribe" below it.

summary.brief: A bright promotional graphic encourages viewers to watch more videos and click to subscribe.
summary.detailed: The final screen shows a static advertisement with a pink background surrounding a central yellow rectangle. Across the top, gray or black text reads “More videos.” Above the yellow rectangle is a stylized red flame icon. Inside the yellow area, bold red lettering says “click to subscribe,” accompanied by a red arrow pointing toward the call‑to‑action. A round gold circle with a white arrow appears below the rectangle, and a small watermark (e.g., “Lakshmi Paakashaale”) is visible in the upper left. Text in a foreign language (likely Kannada) is also present within the yellow box. The overall layout uses vivid colors and bold icons to attract attention.

action.detailed: Show a static graphic that features a pink background, a central yellow rectangle with a red flame icon, the words “More videos” at the top, a red “click to subscribe” button with an arrow, a gold circular emblem, and a watermark.

nodes.plm_caption: An instructional video tutorial for watching on a phone. The video is showing the user interface of an app, of a woman who has a channel and a video of food she made that is playing. The woman is not in the video. The app name is lakshmi paakashaale. The app looks different to a normal app, the background of the app page is nature, there are green leaves and a butterfly, and a brownish wooden background is visible on the sides. The video tutorial is not on the screen at all, but there is the video that is playing on the app, on the center of the screen. The brown table has a light source on it. The object on the lower right corner, the candle, is lit, and there are also some decorative pine cones and branches with pine needles on the upper right corner. There is also a cord on the upper left corner and a red banner with text in it, saying "subscribe now. The app page has a channel logo, and the channel is a female chef, and there is also a video that has played so far, of her cooking, but it is not possible to see her. The name of the app is "lakshmi paakashaale. It looks like a cooking channel app.

	+ It is red with white text that says "SUBSCRIBE NOW".
	+ The ribbon is likely intended to grab the viewer's attention and encourage them to subscribe to the YouTube channel.

To the left and right, there are various small pictures of pine branches, star anise, pine cones, cinnamon sticks, cloves, and a tea light candle in a holder.  The hand pointing to a social media notification.

It begins with a close up shot of homemade chips on a wire rack. The words "Welcome" are shown on top of the food, and a "subscribe now" icon is shown at the top-right. "Lakshmi paakashaale" is written at the top left, and yellow words say "welcome" at the bottom.

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to either of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   A video can match neither, one, or both. Be strict — when in doubt,
   say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
